scope: Short functional UI checks on Parallels Windows 11 ARM64 using an x64 development app. Manual computer-use observations and independently decoded generated files. This is not GA, hardware, accessibility, frame-rate or meeting-share certification.

mouseConfiguration.reason: Relative game-mouse mode caused guest pointer and automated pointer to diverge when GPU capture started. After changing the mouse setting through Parallels UI, actual toolbar click events were logged. Keyboard, security and network settings were not changed.

functionalObservations.name: Two-mode home and setup layout
functionalObservations.detail: Recording and Presentation are separate home cards. Selected native fixture preview is visible. Centered setup width and fixed bottom Start/PNG controls fit the tested window. Presentation default scale is displayed as 1.6.

functionalObservations.name: Theme and settings persistence
functionalObservations.detail: Changed Dark to Light in editor; closed and relaunched app and observed Light on Home. Restored Dark. PNG preview dialog uses the selected dark theme.

functionalObservations.name: Actual recording, trim, zoom, preview and MP4 export
functionalObservations.build: earlier UI build app-x64-build-10107-26012; native DLL unchanged
functionalObservations.detail: Recorded the native fixture until its automatic 180-second fixture lifetime ended. Imported 85.1-second project; retained 0–3 seconds and added a 1.8x manual zoom. GPU playback reached 2.99 seconds and exported a 3-second 1080p MP4 through the folder picker. This export predates later layout/toolbar-only app rebuilds; no earlier app DLL hash was collected for this export.

functionalObservations.name: Edited project survives restart
functionalObservations.detail: Reopened project 118eb6c5d30d4833972e4b607c151574 after app restart: displayed 00:03, 0–3-second range, one 1.8x zoom, saved status and actual fixture frame.

functionalObservations.name: Presentation audience and cover
functionalObservations.detail: Separate audience window starts neutral; live output shows actual fixture. Zoom hotkey displayed 1.6x. Cover switched to neutral output and paused optional recording; un-cover continued it when no manual pause was active. Recording stop hotkey left the presentation session running. Fixture automatic exit switched audience output to neutral/fault with a reselect hint.

functionalObservations.name: Manual recording pause survives cover and uncover
functionalObservations.detail: Clicked recording Start, manual Pause, Cover, Uncover and recording Stop. Recording timer remained at 00:20 after un-cover and status still indicated manual pause. Stopped while paused; did not manually resume recording in this final UI sequence. The separate native presentation test covers recording resume.

functionalObservations.name: End presentation navigation
functionalObservations.detail: Ended presentation after the fixture exited. Main window returned and opened saved presentation project with recorded-camera-path text.

functionalObservations.name: PNG save
functionalObservations.detail: Selected fixture, opened actual screenshot preview, entered a full UNC output filename, waited until text was fully visible, then saved. Independent Pillow decode and color swatches passed.

toolbarTraceScope: Fixed button labels only, written when GLIDE_DEV_DIAGNOSTICS=1; not global input logging.

pngExport.visualReview: Native test-window title, four swatches and moving white marker are present; no app controls in the snapshot.

knownFailures.detail: UI capture samples have maximum inter-frame gaps of 466.67 ms (recording), 400 ms (presentation) and 266.67 ms (final presentation). The independent <250 ms criterion fails. VM scheduling, readback and encoder causes are not isolated; do not dismiss this as VM-only.

First decoded frame has [16,27,31] at all four fixture swatch locations; maximum channel error 230. This is a retained visual-quality failure. Source paint, capture and render causes remain to be isolated.

An earlier Save notification was seen but the intended file and exact default Documents candidate were not found. Kept the failed collection log. The final separate-input-and-save attempt produced the independently verified PNG; earlier success is not used as file evidence.

limitations: No real Zoom/Teams receiver test or separate-output-monitor test.
No mixed-DPI, Narrator, contrast, reduced-motion, GPU-loss or long-duration release matrix.
The fixture auto-exits after 180 seconds; these exits were not app crashes or manual recording stops.
Input text can still be arriving after a CUA call returns. File-picker and numeric edits were explicitly committed before subsequent actions.
Actual UI captures decode fully, but frame-quality failures prevent a quality PASS.
Audio, area capture, cloud sharing, full editor UX and signed install/update work remain.
finalUiState: Dark theme, Home; no active recording or presentation.
